title: Orang Pendek and surviving Flores hominids

tellings.quote: speculate about is the Orang Pendek in Indonesia.

plain: In the forests of Indonesia, people speak of the Orang Pendek, a short, upright, ape-like creature, and some wonder whether it could be a surviving relative of the small early humans whose remains were found on the island of Flores. Jesse Michels raises this himself, as something people speculate about, without naming a source. If true, it would mean another kind of human lived on into recent times.
